result:
`validateApp` now rejects apps without an `owner`, and core-shell, billing and reports pass theirs. I made no change for the platform-kit sub-task (PLAT-103-4). PR #1 on the monorepo is merged, CI and CD both passed, and I've marked the ticket done.

- **Shared contract:** a missing, non-string or blank `owner` throws `app.owner is required`. I bumped `shared-contracts` to 2.0.0 because the change is breaking. It lives in the monorepo and is inlined into the apps at build time, so there was no registry release.
- **Apps:** core-shell passes `platform` and billing passes `payments`, both from their `package.json` `team` field. I built all three apps locally and they compile.
- **Reports app:** `sub-route-reports` also calls `validateApp` but wasn't in the sub-tasks. It would have failed at startup, so I fixed it too and it passes `insights`. It's in the same PR.
- **Platform kit:** `libs-platform-kit` has no `validateApp` call and no dependency on `shared-contracts`. It only exports `formatMoney`. There was nothing to pass or adopt, so I opened no PR and published no release. I recorded this in `st done`. If you meant something else by that sub-task, it needs clarifying.

Everything shipped in a single PR instead of one per sub-task, because the lib is inlined and the lib and app changes have to go out together.

One thing to know: CD only detects changes under `apps/`, so a change to the lib alone would have deployed nothing. That's why the app edits were needed to trigger the deploy.
